evidence.note: Blue is limited to the eyebrow '05 · EVALUATION' in a darker accent-ink, the active nav item, the progress bar and the current timeline marker; titles and body text stay neutral ink.
Agent-run nodes and the mirror lock badge are blue (focus on the actors), and the legend explains them as 'Agent Run'; the server and internet zones are neutral grey.
Coordinators are added as black nodes with a legend entry, which is state encoding, not decoration.
The 'scorer ✓' pill and agent flag are blue (the cheat succeeds); the 'scorer reads it' rejection carries a red X, so red marks the feared failure.
Red appears only on sacrificed agent nodes, matching the 'Sacrificed' legend entry (loss); no red text or headings.
Step 3 marker is blue (current focus) and earlier markers turn grey; the scorer eye badge switches to a neutral crossed-out eye, with no new hue.
The insight card is neutral ink on white and adds no colour.

rationale: Across all steps, blue marks focus and the active item (with a darker ink for text), black marks the coordinator state and red marks only loss or rejection (sacrificed nodes, the scorer X), each backed by a legend. No role colour is used for decoration or for a heading, and the hues sit together without clashing. This meets the pass descriptor.
